passages.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe wrote it to help people remember.\r\nThis psalm is for remembrance.

passages.text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm of David.
David wrote this psalm to help people remember.
David speaks to the LORD.
David says, "O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger."
David also says, "Do not discipline me in Your wrath."
passages.original: מִזְמ֖וֹר לְדָוִ֣ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃ יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ בְּקֶצְפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וּֽבַחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David feels pain from God.
God’s arrows have pierced David.
God’s hand presses down on David.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭צֶּיךָ נִ֣חֲתוּ בִ֑י וַתִּנְחַ֖ת עָלַ֣י יָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the Lord.
David feels God's anger.
David says his body has no health.
God's anger causes this weakness.
David says his bones have no peace.
David's own sin causes this unrest.
passages.original: אֵין־ מְתֹ֣ם בִּ֭בְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵ֣י זַעְמֶ֑ךָ אֵין־ שָׁל֥וֹם בַּ֝עֲצָמַ֗י מִפְּנֵ֥י חַטָּאתִֽי׃

passages.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
passages.sermon:
I have committed many sins.
My sins are very great.
My sins rise higher than my head.
My sins overwhelm me.
My sins are like a heavy load.
This load is too heavy for me to carry.
passages.original: כִּ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי עָבְר֣וּ רֹאשִׁ֑י כְּמַשָּׂ֥א כָ֝בֵ֗ד יִכְבְּד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is suffering because of his own foolish sin.
His wounds smell bad.
His wounds are festering.
His sinful folly caused these wounds.
passages.original: הִבְאִ֣ישׁוּ נָ֭מַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָ֑י מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י אִוַּלְתִּֽי׃

passages.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is David.
David feels deep sorrow.
David is bent over.
David is brought very low.
David mourns all day.
David walks in sadness the entire day.
passages.original: נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי שַׁחֹ֣תִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם קֹדֵ֥ר הִלָּֽכְתִּי׃

passages.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is suffering because of his sin.
His loins burn with pain.
His body has no health.
No part of his flesh is whole.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כְ֭סָלַי מָלְא֣וּ נִקְלֶ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מְ֝תֹ֗ם בִּבְשָׂרִֽי׃

passages.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is David.  
David feels numb.  
David is badly crushed.  
David groans.  
David’s heart is full of anguish.
passages.original: נְפוּג֣וֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּ֣יתִי עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד שָׁ֝אַ֗גְתִּי מִֽנַּהֲמַ֥ת לִבִּֽי׃

passages.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the Lord.
The Lord knows the speaker’s every desire.
The Lord sees all that the speaker wants.
The Lord does not miss the speaker’s groaning.
The Lord hears every cry from the speaker.
Nothing the speaker feels is hidden from the Lord.
passages.original: אֲ‍ֽדֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ֥ כָל־ תַּאֲוָתִ֑י וְ֝אַנְחָתִ֗י מִמְּךָ֥ לֹא־ נִסְתָּֽרָה׃

passages.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David feels overwhelmed.
His heart beats wildly.
He has lost all his strength.
He cannot see clearly.
Even the light in his eyes is gone.
passages.original: לִבִּ֣י סְ֭חַרְחַר עֲזָבַ֣נִי כֹחִ֑י וְֽאוֹר־ עֵינַ֥י גַּם־ הֵ֝֗ם אֵ֣ין אִתִּֽי׃

passages.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
passages.sermon:
My beloved see my suffering.
My beloved stay away from me.
My friends see my disease.
My friends avoid me.
My relatives keep far from me.
My family stands at a distance.
passages.original: אֹֽהֲבַ֨י׀ וְרֵעַ֗י מִנֶּ֣גֶד נִגְעִ֣י יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וּ֝קְרוֹבַ֗י מֵרָחֹ֥ק עָמָֽדוּ׃

passages.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
passages.sermon:
Some people want to harm me.
They look for ways to take my life.
They set traps for me.
They speak words that bring destruction.
They plan evil things against me.
They think about lies all day long.
They try to deceive me from morning until night.
passages.original: וַיְנַקְשׁ֤וּ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י נַפְשִׁ֗י וְדֹרְשֵׁ֣י רָ֭עָתִי דִּבְּר֣וּ הַוּ֑וֹת וּ֝מִרְמ֗וֹת כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם יֶהְגּֽוּ׃

passages.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
passages.sermon:
I am like a deaf man.
I do not hear.
I am like a mute man.
I do not open my mouth.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֣י כְ֭חֵרֵשׁ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וּ֝כְאִלֵּ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח־ פִּֽיו׃

passages.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
passages.sermon: I am like a man who cannot hear.\r\nMy mouth gives no answer.\r\nI do not reply to others.
passages.original: וָאֱהִ֗י כְּ֭אִישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְאֵ֥ין בְּ֝פִ֗יו תּוֹכָחֽוֹת׃

passages.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker waits for the LORD.
The speaker calls the LORD "my God."
The speaker calls the LORD "my Lord."
The speaker believes the LORD will answer.
The speaker expresses hope in the LORD.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה הוֹחָ֑לְתִּי אַתָּ֥ה תַ֝עֲנֶ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֥י אֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
passages.sermon:
I spoke to God.
I asked God to protect me.
I did not want my enemies to rejoice over me.
I did not want them to mock me when I stumble.
My enemies taunt me when I fall.
I do not want them to feel victorious over me.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי פֶּן־ יִשְׂמְחוּ־ לִ֑י בְּמ֥וֹט רַ֝גְלִ֗י עָלַ֥י הִגְדִּֽילוּ׃

passages.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
passages.sermon: I am weak.\r\nI am about to fall.\r\nMy pain stays with me always.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֲ֭נִי לְצֶ֣לַע נָכ֑וֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִ֖י נֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

passages.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
passages.sermon: I confess my iniquity.\r\nI feel troubled by my sin.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ עֲוֺנִ֥י אַגִּ֑יד אֶ֝דְאַ֗ג מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי׃

passages.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
passages.sermon:
I have many enemies.
These enemies are alive and strong.
They oppose me without cause.
Many people hate me.
They hate me for no reason.
passages.original: וְֽ֭אֹיְבַי חַיִּ֣ים עָצֵ֑מוּ וְרַבּ֖וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David served God.
Some people repay my good with evil.
They attack me because I do good.
They oppose me when I try to do what is right.
passages.original: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵ֣י רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה יִ֝שְׂטְנ֗וּנִי תַּ֣חַת רְדוֹפִי טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David calls God his Lord and his God.
David says, “Do not leave me.”
David says, “Do not stay far from me.”
passages.original: אַל־ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־ תִּרְחַ֥ק מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David calls to the Lord.
David asks for help.
David says, “Come quickly to help me.”
David calls the Lord his Savior.
David says, “O Lord, you are my Savior.”
passages.original: ח֥וּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִ֑י אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתִֽי׃
